The '''Corellian cutlass''' was a short, curved [[Sword/Legends|saber]] presented to officers of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian Defense Forces Space Service|Naval Forces]] once they attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. While primarily ornamental in nature, they were still quite useful in close-quarters combat and were highly prized for their excellent craftmanship.
